purpose: Capacity points for the W2a sweep. Each point is (k, n, C, c_top): stage-A candidates, papers after the stage-A reranker, chunk candidates from those papers, chunks after the stage-B reranker.
rule: c_top is a filter only where it is below C. The two default points differ in nothing else, which is the point: they establish that stage B reorders rather than prunes at the shipped settings.
